# Michael Ciccarelli — Software Engineer

> Michael Ciccarelli is an independent software engineer building for the web. He works across design and engineering, creating websites, applications, and digital products for clients and through self-initiated projects. His focus is frontend engineering, interaction, and design systems.

Personal site of Michael Ciccarelli, based in Las Vegas. Sometimes he plays poker, and takes photos: https://relli.cc/photos.

## Studio and products

- [Third Index](https://thirdindex.co): Independent technology studio (2025). Client work lives there. Book an intro call at https://cal.com/ciccarelli/intro.
- [bkrl.app](https://bkrl.app): Bankroll management for poker players (2026). Log sessions in natural language, track variance and ROI.
- [spread.now](https://spread.now): A live board of US poker and sports (2026).

## Experience

- Principal Engineer, Third Index — Las Vegas / Remote, 2025–present (leads design and engineering for web applications, product interfaces, and custom software; end-to-end builds across frontend, backend, APIs, infrastructure, and deployment; built bkrl.app)
- Design Engineer, Modern Treasury — New York, 2024–2025 (enterprise fintech interfaces and UI components, design systems, motion patterns, headless CMS)
- Senior Frontend Engineer, Metropolis — Brooklyn, 2022–2024 (metal.build, pod.xyz, EVM dApps, Farcaster integrations; led frontend architecture for Web3 interfaces)
- Senior Engineer II, Axoni — New York, 2021–2022 (React apps, data visualizations, UI libraries for fintech)
- Lead Frontend Engineer, VICE Media — Brooklyn, 2014–2018 (led team of 10; publishing platform across VICE properties; LAMP-to-React migration)
- Web Developer, Condé Nast — New York, 2012–2014 (GQ, Wired, Architectural Digest)
